title: Haye Chacha Jaan
body:
aati hai qaime ke dar se ye sada
abbas abbas abbas
aaye nahi kyon nehr se ab tak chacha
abbas abbas abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ghul hai ye kaisa macha
haye chacha jaan mere
saaniha guzra hai kya
haye chacha jaan mere
karte hai sab kyun buka
haye chacha jaan mere
ghutne laga dam mera
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba bhi hai nauhagar
haye chacha jaan mere
peet'te hai apna sar
haye chacha jaan mere
reh gaye kyon nehr par
haye chacha jaan mere
laut ke aaye na ghar
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
dayr kyun itni lagi
haye chacha jaan mere
kyun na khabar meri li
haye chacha jaan mere
yaad na aayi meri
haye chacha jaan mere
mujhse khata kya hui
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime…
<<DIVIDER>>
dayr ka hai kya sabab
haye chacha jaan mere
dard hai dil mein ajab
haye chacha jaan mere
pyaas se hoo jaan-balab
haye chacha jaan mere
dekhiye aate hai kab
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime…
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hai sab ghar ka ghar
haye chacha jaan mere
pakde hai baba kamar
haye chacha jaan mere
kar gaye kis ja safar
haye chacha jaan mere
shor hai kyon nehr par
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime…
<<DIVIDER>>
milti nahi kuch khabar
haye chacha jaan mere
kya karoon jaa'un kidhar
haye chacha jaan mere
hogaya veeran ghar
haye chacha jaan mere
lagta hai ab mujhko darr
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime…
<<DIVIDER>>
karti hoo jab mai fughan
haye chacha jaan mere
rote hai shaahe zamaan
haye chacha jaan mere
kis se karoon ye bayan
haye chacha jaan mere
waqt hai na mehrban
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime…
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoondne jaa'un kahan
haye chacha jaan mere
mere anees ho kahan
haye chacha jaan mere
hashr hai ghar mein ayaan
haye chacha jaan mere
pyaas se dil hai tapaan
haye chacha jaan mere
aati hai qaime…
author: Anees Pehersari
